title: 1890s airship mystery and NYMZA, per Walter Bosley and Joseph Farrell

tellings.quote: What I'm worried about is uh Walter Bosley, you know, the friend of Dr. Joseph Pharaoh, Walter Bosley, the whole idea of Nenza. Who the were these guys? The airship quote unquote mystery.

related.note: Both are about the 1890s airship sightings. The story treats them as culturally shaped perception, while this telling, following Bosley and Farrell, ties them to a real secret group called NYMZA.

plain: In the 1890s, people across the United States reported mysterious airships in the sky, and a researcher named Walter Bosley, a friend of the writer Joseph Farrell, has argued that a group he calls NYMZA was behind them. Salvatore Pais, a Navy scientist known for patents on unusual craft, raises it on the show without spelling out the details, asking "Who were these guys?" and saying the idea worries him, since it would mean someone was flying advanced craft long before anyone admitted it.
